subject: Kickoff: Reviews2Movielens as a first-class internal benchmark
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the Reviews2Movielens effort. The dataset from our DocEnt open-source release joins the Movies and TV subset of Amazon Reviews with MovieLens tags — nearly 8.8 million reviews once joined — and it's exactly the multi-document, multi-label testbed our retrieval and recs teams keep asking for.

What this unlocks: a standard benchmark for entity-representation models inside Meridian, plus a story for the data-platforms OKR on shared evaluation assets.

Rough milestones inside our window: ingestion into Corpus by end of Feb, benchmark spec and baseline numbers by end of March, internal GA with docs by mid-May. Note Corpus is mid-v2-migration, so Ivo please sanity-check the ingestion path with Jun Varga's team early.

Dmitri
